DEEPAK SINGH CHAUHAN

Generative AI Product Manager | LLM, RAG & Enterprise AI Innovation

Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India | 8144704682 | Kartik2611@gmail.com LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/deepakiitmadras

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Generative AI Product Manager with 8+ years of experience in enterprise product management, AI innovation, digital transformation, supply chain, digital twins, blockchain, e- commerce, healthcare, and engineering systems. Led GenAI innovation work for LA Times, including use-case discovery, roadmap planning, requirements management, solution blueprinting, stakeholder alignment, and ROI analysis.

Strong technical product foundation in LLM applications, RAG concepts, prompt engineering, embeddings, semantic search, AI evaluation, NLP, machine learning, Python, and responsible AI. Skilled at translating business challenges into practical AI product opportunities and working with business, engineering, data, architecture, and executive stakeholders to deliver outcomes.

CORE SKILLS

GenAI & AI Product: GenAI strategy, LLM applications, RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, semantic search, vector database concepts, document intelligence, AI copilots, AI agents/tool-calling concepts, fine-tuning concepts

AI Quality & Governance: AI evaluation, relevance, groundedness, factuality, hallucination mitigation, guardrails, human-in-the-loop, prompt-injection awareness, privacy, PII handling, access controls, responsible AI

Product Management: Product discovery, roadmaps, PRDs, user stories, backlog prioritization, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, sprint planning, UAT, stakeholder management, ROI analysis, risk management, pre-sales consulting

Technical: Python, MATLAB, SQL, NLP, machine-learning concepts, Power BI, Tableau, AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

TECH MAHINDRA

Product Manager / Product Owner — GenAI & Digital Transformation | Oct 2022 – Nov 2025

Led end-to-end product ownership across Generative AI, supply-chain automation, smart infrastructure, and digital-twin initiatives.

Led a GenAI innovation project for LA Times, defining use cases, product roadmap, requirements, solution blueprints, stakeholder alignment, and ROI analysis.

Partnered with client executives to identify business challenges and prioritize AI, automation, and digital-transformation opportunities.

Defined LLM-powered product opportunities including knowledge assistants, document intelligence, contextual search, workflow copilots, summarization, and enterprise automation.

Worked with business, architecture, engineering, data, and consulting teams to create product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery roadmaps.

Contributed to RAG solution requirements involving trusted data sources, content ingestion, retrieval, source-grounded responses, citations, access controls, and feedback mechanisms.

Defined AI success metrics around adoption, task completion, response relevance, productivity improvement, customer satisfaction, cost, and ROI.

Supported responsible-AI requirements including hallucination mitigation, privacy, guardrails, human review, data-access controls, and risk management.

Managed backlog, prioritization, sprint planning, UAT, delivery governance, and stakeholder communication for the UPS Supply Chain Product.

Led digital-twin development for the Smart Island project at NEOM and supported pre-sales through AI use-case decks and solution blueprints.

PHOTON INTERACTIVE PVT. LTD., BENGALURU

Product Owner | Mar 2022 – Sep 2022

Owned requirements, backlogs, sprint priorities, delivery coordination, UAT, and stakeholder communication for e-commerce and healthcare clients.

Led business, functional, technical, and creative discovery workshops to identify high-value product opportunities.

Delivered an enterprise e-commerce platform and a healthcare digital-transformation initiative from concept through launch.

Converted customer requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, product priorities, and Agile delivery plans.

KFUPM, SAUDI ARABIA

Offshore Researcher / Consultant | Jan 2019 – Dec 2020

Contributed to a remote-sensing research project using Python and MATLAB for data analysis, computational modeling, simulation, and interpretation.

MINERSINC (STARTUP)

Research Product Manager | Mar 2018 – Jan 2019

Led product discovery, R&D, strategic planning, and roadmap management for a blockchain-based OTT platform.

Developed mathematical models and algorithms supporting transaction integrity and recommendation-system capabilities.

Aligned technology development with market needs, business objectives, and early- stage product direction.

EARLIER EXPERIENCE

Senior Software Engineer, KPIT Technologies | Sep 2016 – Apr 2017 Automotive modeling and simulation proof-of-concept work.

Model-Based Design Engineer, HCL Technologies | Jul 2015 – Mar 2016 Automotive and avionics modeling and simulation using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow.

Research Assistant, IIT Madras — MHRD Fellowship | Jul 2012 – Jul 2015 Research in missile guidance, radar tracking, flight dynamics, navigation, control systems, and computational simulation.

EDUCATION

IIT MADRAS

MS by Research — Naval Architecture & Ocean Engineering | 2012 – 2015 CGPA: 8.4/10 | MHRD Scholarship Holder Thesis: A Computing-Based Simulation Model for Missile Guidance in Planar Domain

THE AERONAUTICAL SOCIETY OF INDIA

Bachelor of Engineering — Aeronautical Engineering, Avionics | 2007 – 2012 All India topper in Maintenance of Radio and Communication Systems.

GATE 2012: All India Rank 93 — XE

CERTIFICATIONS

SAFe Certified Product Owner / Product Manager (POPM), 2025

Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), 2025

PRINCE2 Foundation and Practitioner, 2025

Leadership for Program Management — Level 1, 2025

Google AI White Belt, 2025

SELECTED PUBLICATIONS



“A Computing-Based Simulation Model for Missile Guidance in Planar Domain,” Journal of The Institution of Engineers (India): Series C, 2017. DOI: 10.1007/s40032-017-0386-6





“Computing-Based Simulation Model for Missile Guidance,” IEEE CSNT, 2016

“A Computational Model for Navigational Law Simulation,” ICCMS, 2016
